d: In a bizarre move, doctors have been deployed outside liquor shops in Sagar, Madhya Pradesh. People visiting wine shops are being offered health check-ups, blood tests and medical counselling. The campaign includes liver and kidney health assessments to warn people about excessive alcohol consumption. The initiative comes after 20 deaths linked to the suspected spurious liquor tragedy in Sagar's Banda area, according to the state government's report submitted to the High Court.
